name: Build To Break Bones!
desc:
💥 Welcome to Build To Break Ur Bones!

🧱 Build & Customize Your Ramp
• Buy and place all kinds of crazy obstacles: spikes, bombs, ramps, and more!
• Mix and match to create the most chaotic ramp possible!

🚀 Upgrade Your Ramp
• Extend your ramp for even bigger falls and crazier combos!
• Increase your obstacle limit and earn bonus cash with every upgrade!

💰 Earn Money while Offline!
• Your ramp keeps generating cash offline, so you’re always making progress!

🎁 Collect Limited-Time Obstacles!

💾 Your Progress Saves Automatically!
